---
title: "Shared feedback integration workbench"
---

This page combines the current branches of all four extensions. It is the
baseline before migrating feedback into the shared API. The standalone text
activity uses the shared cogwheel; mathematics and Pyodide still use their
existing feedback implementations. Python unit-test exercises have no feedback
adapter yet. This page will gain migration checks alongside each adapter.

[Exact revisions used for this build](resolved-repos.json)

## Shared AI feedback

::: {.ai-feedback #shared-writing profile="language-quality" response-language="es" feedback-language="en" learner-level="Spanish course 1" context="none"}

## Python unit-test exercise

Implement addition, then choose **Check**. The starter deliberately subtracts.
Use **Reset** to restore it. This is the first planned shared-feedback consumer.

```{py-exercise}
#| label: integration-add
#| forbidden-imports: os
#| show-test-hints: true
def add(a, b):
    return a - b

## TESTS ##
assert add(1, 2) == 3, "add(1, 2) should return 3"
assert add(0, 0) == 0, "add(0, 0) should return 0"
assert add(-1, 1) == 0, "add(-1, 1) should return 0"
```

## Mathematics

Enter the numerical answer and choose **Check**. The legacy Feedback button is
also present; it will move to the shared API in a later migration.

```{math-exercise}
#| label: integration-math
What is $6\cdot7$? _[42]
```

## Interactive Python

Run this code and check that the output is **6**. Its existing three-stage
feedback will be migrated after py-exercise.

```{pyodide-python}
#| label: integration-python
values = [1, 2, 3]
print(sum(values))
```
